lead_headline: Villa Tourism Reaches New Heights in Kaş and Kalkan
lead_deck: Villa stays in the region are expected to reach their highest level in July.
lead_body: Villa tourism in Kaş and Kalkan continues to rise. Industry representatives expect demand for accommodation to peak in July.
Independent accommodation options preferred by holidaymakers increase the region's tourism capacity while contributing to the local economy.
